title: Torn-Out Spaces
style: Aggressive experimental dubstep with heavy broadband static and deep brown-noise beds, distorted female soprano lead, clipped intimate verses opening into huge half-time drops, snarling wobble bass, metallic impacts, granular noise cuts, abrupt breakdowns and a final drop that collapses into hiss; dense, abrasive, deliberately lo-fi texture with clear vocal presence.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Six scraps pinned to a page gone brown
One crossed-out line, one made-up sound
Staff lines curl where the margins bend
A stained little word says Spider again

[Pre-Chorus]
You turn the page, I change my shape
A voice in pieces, a phrase escaping

[Chorus]
Translate me through the torn-out spaces
Leave the blank where the meaning breaks
You take my words, you rearrange them
I come back strange, but I still remain

[Verse 2]
Latin curls and Arabic ink
A careful hand I cannot read
Cyrillic marks, then empty squares
Lost little tongues suspended there

[Chorus]
Translate me through the torn-out spaces
Leave the blank where the meaning breaks
You take my words, you rearrange them
I come back strange, but I still remain

[Bridge]
Four faces pinned above the desk
Purple, teal, red, one turned away
Empty bubbles wait beside the page
A pencil circles what I couldn’t say

[Drop]
Cut the line
Keep the stain
Turn the page
Say my name

[Final Chorus]
Translate me through the torn-out spaces
Leave the blank where the meaning breaks
You take my words, you rearrange them
I come back strange, but I still remain

[Outro]
The drafts stay open
The ink runs thin
A page goes quiet
The noise gets in
